meta.aboutLong:
Mobile Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience building cross-platform mobile apps for Android and iOS. Skilled in developing responsive UI, scalable architectures, and integrating modern mobile technologies.

Currently working on Canara Bank's Fintech product with a user base of 80 Million+ people. Developed multiple production Flutter applications, built responsive UI and scalable mobile architectures, and worked with APIs, Firebase, and enterprise mobile environments.

Currently exploring advanced Flutter patterns, native iOS development, and Fintech Operations.
